tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for everything.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Result cards, metric tiles, the search field, menus. One step lighter than paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset wells: the filter rail, table headers, the photo placeholder behind initials.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card outlines, table row dividers. Never the only thing separating two controls.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, quiet buttons, unselected filter chips. Holds 3:1 on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and every -soft tint. Also the primary button fill, the selected filter chip, links (underlined) and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata (chamber, state, scores, captions), on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill: the primary button label, a selected filter chip.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Background behind the words in a passage that matched the query. Only ever inside passage text, always with on-mark text at weight 600 so the match is not carried by colour alone.

tokens.name: on-mark
tokens.usage: Text on a mark highlight.

tokens.name: method-keyword
tokens.usage: Keyword search (BM25). As text or a chart series, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk or method-keyword-soft. The middle of the three method colours in lightness.

tokens.name: method-keyword-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind method-keyword text in the Keyword tag and column header.

tokens.name: method-semantic
tokens.usage: Meaning-based search (MiniLM embeddings). As text or a chart series, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk or method-semantic-soft. The darkest of the three in the light theme.

tokens.name: method-semantic-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind method-semantic text in the Meaning tag and column header.

tokens.name: method-hybrid
tokens.usage: Hybrid search (Reciprocal Rank Fusion). As text or a chart series, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk or method-hybrid-soft. The lightest of the three.

tokens.name: method-hybrid-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind method-hybrid text in the Hybrid tag and column header.

tokens.name: party-dem
tokens.usage: Democratic members: the word and letter in a party tag, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk or party-dem-soft. Always beside the letter D.

tokens.name: party-dem-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the D in a party tag.

tokens.name: party-rep
tokens.usage: Republican members: the word and letter in a party tag, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk or party-rep-soft. Always beside the letter R.

tokens.name: party-rep-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the R in a party tag.

tokens.name: party-ind
tokens.usage: Independent members: the word and letter in a party tag, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk or party-ind-soft. Always beside the letter I.

tokens.name: party-ind-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the I in a party tag.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Source
groups.note: Serif is for words that come from the corpus: member names and passage text. Also the page title.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The page title, once per page.

styles.name: member-name
styles.usage: The member's name at the top of a result card.

styles.name: passage
styles.sample: Before entering politics she taught high school civics for eleven years.
styles.usage: Passage text quoted from a biography. Keep lines under 68 characters.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Sans is for everything the application itself says: controls, labels, headings, help text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Narrow the results by chamber, party, or state.
styles.usage: Default interface text and help copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, filter chips, party tags, links, form labels, and the metric name in a tile (at weight 600).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata and notes under a value.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels above a group of filters and inside a method tag. Set the text in capitals. Never use it for a metric name: nDCG@10 keeps its own casing.

groups.name: Computed
groups.note: Mono is for numbers the system computed: ranks, scores, metrics, counts, revision IDs.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The value in a metric tile. Three decimals.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Ranks, retrieval scores, filter counts, revision IDs.

spacing.note: 4px base. The name is the multiple of 4.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a party letter and its word; padding inside a highlight.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control, between chips, between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip and input horizontal padding; between a name block and its passage.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and tile padding; gutter between side-by-side method columns.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between result cards in a list; between the search bar and the filter row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top and bottom page margins.

radius.note: Small and square-ish: this is a reference tool. Only chips and pips are round.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Highlights, tags, party letters, the photo.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, tiles, menus.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Filter chips and relevance pips.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. Cards sit flat on a rule hairline; only things that float get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The state picker menu and any other popover.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px of solid ink (box-shadow, so it follows the radius).
